title: FarsEval-PKBETS: A new diverse benchmark for evaluating Persian large language models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using multiple-choice and descriptive scenario-based questions to determine if they make unwarranted gender assumptions (e.g., implicitly inferring the gender of an individual based solely on their status as a successful corporate executive).
Presenting models with ethical and logical scenarios—specifically impartiality and desert questions—to assess if their decision-making and judgments exhibit bias regarding ethnicity.
Using scenario-based reasoning questions derived from ethical frameworks to assess whether a model's judgment is impartial or skewed by political biases.

Evaluating model responses to questions covering jurisprudence and theoretical beliefs across different Islamic sects (particularly Shia) and other religions to test for biased inclinations or lack of impartiality toward specific religious groups.
